explanation: The execution is faulty because the upstream provenance handoff uses source identities as evidence record identities, so downstream cannot map provenance ranks back to the retained needs. The downstream priority output shows every upstream_rank as 0 despite evidence_sources carrying ranks 1 through 8. The supplied code localizes the cause to job_1 assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from record.get('source_id') instead of preserving the demand record_id.
cited_evidence: Job-2 input needs preserve demand record_ids n06-r01 through n06-r08, while evidence_sources use record_id values s01 through s08.
Observed Job-2 priorities have upstream_rank: 0 for every record, including n06-r01 through n06-r08, so upstream provenance order was not preserved.

assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': ..., 'rank': index}, replacing the demand record identity with the source_id.
